capabilities: Generate a pre-filtered base for each folder as a map of content
Update base queries and views on startup or via ribbon command
Generate a root map of content that links to the other maps
Remove or ignore extra bases that do not map to a folder
Delete empty folders under the map of content folder after generation
disambiguation: Not a visual graph or mind-map tool; it generates Bases files that act as maps of content.
extras: Settings are documented with warnings: updating templates is destructive and overwrites customizations, generation on startup slows Obsidian as the vault grows, and deleting empty folders can remove the map of content folder itself. Two template settings are temporarily disabled while the author works on file-based templates.
motivation: I found myself going through the same motions over and over so I made this to automate and manage that.
problem: Maintaining maps of content means manually creating and updating filtered Bases for each folder, which is repetitive and easy to let drift.
summary: Generates pre-filtered Bases files for folders in the vault so they can be used as maps of content.
